title: Mind Fuck
description:
You’ve come to my office for additional Relaxation Therapy. You soon learn, that I’ve been programming & playing with your mind in an unexpected way this entire time. Fucking your mind deeply with my programming…. in… and out.

I will be working with a couple of new triggers on you, and testing them out. In the process, you will be teased, denied, played with, and taunted. My wicked sense of fun is both tortuous and exhilarating all at the same time while I fuck your mind… and fuck WITH your mind.
